title: Rldcoin: Open Mining and Payments Across Delayed Networks
authorization_scope: Owner authorized reconciliation to the completed survivor-first specification: reversible payments, continued mining by any capable surviving full node and authenticated delayed carriage. This replaces mandatory regional quorum finality, irreversible exports/imports and the former seconds-scale final-spendability target. Historical networks and source-qualified failures are not changed.
qualification: Design publication only. No mainnet, automatic adoption, test-value migration, independent implementation/security/custody qualification or operational interstellar route is established.
acceptance: G1-G6 map to T01-T22 in the content-bound specification. Supply cap, zero initial allocation, exact issuance, owner authorization, full replay and independent qualification remain mandatory.
